targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM security_events WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM security_events WHERE rule_level >= 12 AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM security_events WHERE correlated = true AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM security_events WHERE auto_response IS NOT NULL AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, COUNT(*) AS events FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN rule_level >= 12 THEN 'Critical' WHEN rule_level >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN rule_level >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM security_events WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, agent_name, rule_level, rule_description, src_ip::text, dst_ip::text FROM security_events WHERE rule_level >= 7 AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT src_ip::text AS source, COUNT(*) AS events, MAX(rule_level) AS max_level FROM security_events WHERE src_ip IS NOT NULL AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT host_name, ROUND(score::numeric, 2) AS threat_score, ts AS last_updated FROM host_threat_scores WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10
